shared_gates.label: PROVED
shared_gates.statement: Package membership, installation, registration, visibility, authorization, execution and backend availability are separate states. Installed records persist as AppManager_JavaApps; finalization updates app objects, emits appListUpdated and conditionally autostarts.

shared_gates.label: PROVED
shared_gates.statement: Native updateShowInHmi writes object+0x4d; catalog paths test it before inclusion. Conditions are evaluated when byte+0x29a has mask 8 OR byte+0x294 is nonzero. Otherwise most apps default visible; ASSIST has a separate suppression branch.

shared_gates.label: UNKNOWN
shared_gates.statement: Visibility flag provenance and the exact meaning of virtual catalog predicates are unresolved. Do not rename these bytes as a proved DRM entitlement or unconditionally infer PPS from a tile.

shared_gates.label: PROVED
shared_gates.statement: With every attribute present, alternatives within a condition use equality/OR; a nonmatching condition exits false. Missing attributes set false but continue, so a later condition can overwrite the value.

shared_gates.label: PROVED
shared_gates.statement: Normal startApp enables DRM checking. Conditional autostart uses launcher-mask bit 2 or super-app override, plus the global gate. A tile is not successful launch authorization.
